responsibility: Serves as the top-level `rustc_mir::dataflow` module, reexporting the framework API and concrete analyses while defining shared support types such as `MoveDataParamEnv`, index aliases, and attribute lookup for `rustc_mir` dataflow/graphviz configuration.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the top-level `dataflow` facade, reexporting framework pieces and concrete analyses while defining a few shared support types. Unlike the other dataflow `mod.rs` files, it is not the generic engine implementation nor a concrete analysis collection by itself, but the umbrella module connecting them.
